Enum Class CellState

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CellState>
moldsim.model.CellState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CellState>, Constable
public enum CellState extends Enum<CellState>
Represents all possible states of a cell in the simulation.

These states describe whether a cell is healthy, contains spores, is infected, is sporulating, or is dead.
